title: What Interspecies Internet Is
definition: Interspecies Internet: networks including nonhuman participants.
description:
Strip Interspecies Internet to its essence and you get networks including nonhuman participants. Simple to say, civilizational to build.

The path runs through Future Communications & Interfaces: first species gateways understanding, then network logistics prototypes, then signal translation operations at scale. Each stage has its own physics, its own economics, and its own failure modes — this database maps all three.

Use the ladder: start with foundations, work through the components and forecasts, run every demo, then attempt the compounded drills. By the final record you will hold a working mental model of network hulls, grounded in real research and honest about what remains unknown.

title: Real Research Today: Interspecies Internet
definition: Today's documented research behind Interspecies Internet.
description:
The road to Interspecies Internet is already being paved. Meta's EMG wristband and Neuralink's implants advance neural input devices. Volumetric video capture (Microsoft Mixed Reality Capture) records full-3D performances.

Holographic display research (MIT Media Lab, Looking Glass) builds glasses-free 3D. Together these programs form the species gateways foundation that Interspecies Internet will build on — the network logistics results, the signal translation methods, and the institutional memory.

Forecasts are projections, not promises: the dated milestones in this database reflect published roadmaps and expert surveys, and they will move as network logistics research advances. Treat every date as a planning scenario with error bars, and watch the signals listed in each milestone record.

t: 2030 — First consumer network hulls terminals ship: species gateways in
title: 2030 — First consumer network hulls terminals ship: species gateways in
definition: 2030 milestone on the Interspecies Internet roadmap.
description:
First consumer network hulls terminals ship: species gateways input plus network logistics output in one wearable.

What must be true first: the species gateways results have to replicate outside the lab, network logistics manufacturing must reach pilot scale, and signal translation operations need a year of continuous runtime. Miss any one and the date slips — that is the honest mechanics of forecasting.

Signals to watch: peer-reviewed species gateways demonstrations, network logistics cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting signal translation uptime. When all three flash green, 2030 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (4 years from the 2026 baseline.)

title: Readiness Estimator: Interspecies Internet
definition: Estimates Interspecies Internet readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Interspecies Internet components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a network hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where species gateways monitoring, network logistics redundancy, or signal translation maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Interspecies Internet Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Interspecies Internet: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Interspecies Internet — networks including nonhuman participants.

Phase 1 — Prove (species gateways): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (network logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (signal translation): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (consent models): network hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and research-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
